name: Haine to Rikuto to Mittsu no Sentaku (Ecchi）
original_name: ハイネとリクトと三つの選択 (えっち）
source: Once upon a time, there lived Haine and Rikuto (and a few others). Haine and Rikuto are madly in love with each other! Tonight, too... they’re having a great time. But it seems Rikuto has something on his mind...?
translation: 从前，住着海恩和陆斗（以及其他一些人）。海涅和陆斗疯狂地相爱了！今晚也是……他们玩得很开心。不过陆斗似乎有什么心事……？
